# Dr Amit Druyan — Senior Rheumatologist

> Official website of Dr Amit Druyan (also written: Druyan, Amit Druyan, עמית דרוין), senior rheumatologist and internal medicine specialist at Sheba Medical Center (Tel HaShomer), Israel.

Dr Amit Druyan is a board-certified specialist in Rheumatology and Internal Medicine with over 20 years of clinical experience. He leads the acute inpatient arthritis service and runs the FMF (Familial Mediterranean Fever) clinic at Sheba Medical Center — one of the world's top-ranked academic hospitals. He is a lecturer at Tel Aviv University School of Medicine and a member of the Israeli Rheumatology Association.

## Conditions treated

- Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA)
- Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF)
- Ankylosing Spondylitis
- Psoriatic Arthritis
- Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
- Vasculitis
- Scleroderma
- Gout
- Polymyalgia Rheumatica (PMR)
- Behçet Disease
- Connective Tissue Disease

## Credentials

- Medical degree: Hebrew University–Hadassah Medical School, Jerusalem (Academic Reserve program)
- Residency: Internal Medicine, Sheba Medical Center
- Fellowship: Rheumatology, Sheba Medical Center
- Member: Israeli Rheumatology Association
- Lecturer: Tel Aviv University School of Medicine
